note: The game uses only project-generated images. The mascots use a generated chat atlas from the references list. The core portraits use a revision of a generated candidate. front-room-00 and courtyard-13 use generated room references. The decoration paintings use generated design references. Each later room state edits the previous state of its area. Each composite retains only the changed region. The board-clutter atlas uses chat generation and cell corrections. The second regulars atlas revises its previous version, and the references list keeps that version. Each pencil sheet is drawn in one request, so that its drawings share one hand. The 16 food atlases use alpha cuts, moves, box clears, and cell copies between candidates, without painted pixels. The two rat sheets use generated identity references from the references list. The thief rat sheet uses a cell trim, without painted pixels. This record preserves the source and review evidence of the current assets. This record does not give legal clearance.
